origin.summary: Workout 2 of the 2012 CrossFit Open. The Open is the worldwide online qualifying stage of the CrossFit Games season: one workout released each week, completed and scored by hundreds of thousands of athletes in affiliates and garages on the same few days.

description: A 10-minute ascending-load snatch ladder — three fixed sets of 30 reps at increasingly heavy weights, then max reps at the heaviest load for the remainder of the time cap.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/open/2012/2 (official CrossFit Games Open workout), retrieved 2026-07-09
